title: HireMe
description: Job search command centre — funnel, priorities and activity in one view. Public case study coming after the first cohort of users.
problem: Job search work fragments fast: jobs scattered across tabs, applications half-tracked in spreadsheets, no signal on priorities or pipeline health.
system: One dashboard for the whole funnel — saved jobs, applied, interview pipeline, offers — with an activity log and quick filters by priority and status.
artifact: Private PWA live in the app workspace. Public site and write-up scheduled after the first cohort of users.
outcome: A scattered job search becomes a single prioritised system. Public proof TBD.
